page_title: CAG 2-2 JUV | Cagliari v Juventus 19/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.
90+5' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) gets inside the box and tries to beat Simone Scuffet with a measured shot into the bottom right corner, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
90+3' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.
90+2' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' A pass from Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) is intercepted by Simone Scuffet and the move breaks down.
89' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) overhits the corner kick and none of his teammates can their head on it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Juventus.
88' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared. Cagliari have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
87' Substitution. Pantelis Hatzidiakos walks off the pitch and Mateusz Wieteska (Cagliari) comes on as a substitute.

87' 2 - 2 An unfortunate own goal is conceded by Alberto Dossena (Cagliari), who attempted to block the ball after a cross, but instead he sends it into the middle of his own goal and behind the goalkeeper.
86' A substitution has been made. Andrea Cambiaso is replaced by Samuel Iling Junior (Juventus).
85' The referee blows his whistle after Arkadiusz Milik (Juventus) does a good impression of a basketball player and handles the ball.
83' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) leans back and sends a volley soaring over the bar from inside the box.
81' The resulting corner from Federico Chiesa (Juventus) is cleared.

80' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. The referee signals a corner kick to Juventus.
79' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) is coming onto the pitch as Eldor Shomurodov cannot continue after picking up an injury.
79' Claudio Ranieri has decided to substitute Nahitan Nandez and he is replaced by Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari).
75' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) is penalised for a foul. Marco Piccinini had a clear view and blows his whistle.
74' A substitution has been made. Manuel Locatelli goes off and Arkadiusz Milik (Juventus) comes on.
74' Adrien Rabiot (Juventus) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.

70' Federico Chiesa (Juventus) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.
69' Here is a change. Gianluca Gaetano is going off and Claudio Ranieri gives the last tactical orders to Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari).
68' The game has come to an end for Timothy Weah (Juventus). He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Weston McKennie.
68' Federico Chiesa pings in the corner towards the centre of the box and finds Adrien Rabiot (Juventus) unmarked, but his free header is woeful and slips well over the bar.
67' Federico Chiesa (Juventus) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
66' The ball is cleared after Eldor Shomurodov (Cagliari) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
65' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) sends a long cross over to Eldor Shomurodov, but Wojciech Szczesny comes forward to gather the ball.
61' 2 - 1 It's a goal! Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) scores a beautiful goal from the resulting free kick. The ball ends up inside the left post. Superb strike!
60' Juventus get the opportunity to endanger the opposition's goal with a free kick from the edge of the box.
60' The referee is firm and issues Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) a deserved yellow card.
58' Federico Chiesa (Juventus) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Simone Scuffet intercepts the ball.
57' Bremer (Juventus) sends a long ball in, but Simone Scuffet comfortably gathers the ball.

56' Adrien Rabiot (Juventus) wins some space for himself around the penalty spot and manages to produce a promising header. One of the defenders stops his effort before it gets to the goalkeeper, making him redundant.
52' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
51' Matteo Prati (Cagliari) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the left side of the goal, but Wojciech Szczesny was alert and made a comfortable save.
50' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) is caught offside, but it was a really close call.
48' Eldor Shomurodov (Cagliari) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
48' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Bremer (Juventus) was quite harsh and Marco Piccinini didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
46' Claudio Ranieri has made a change at the break. Matteo Prati has come on in place of Ibrahim Sulemana (Cagliari).
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Carlos Alcaraz (Juventus) comes off for Kenan Yildiz.
46' Referee Marco Piccinini blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+6' Federico Chiesa (Juventus) is flagged for offside.
45+2' Timothy Weah (Juventus) can count himself lucky for not being sent off after only receiving a caution from the referee.
45+2' The foul by Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) was seen by Marco Piccinini who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
45+2' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) behaves unsportingly. Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected. Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) will miss the next game.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
45' The goal by Juventus is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
44' Possible change! There could be offside in the lead up. Referee Marco Piccinini wants to look at it, so he’s going to review using VAR.
43' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) has a goal ruled out for offside!
43' A crossfield pass from Bremer (Juventus) fails to find any of his teammates. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
41' Antoine Makoumbou (Cagliari) commits a rough foul. Marco Piccinini stops the game and makes a call. Juventus win a free kick.
40' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Wojciech Szczesny, who smothers the ball.
38' Carlos Alcaraz (Juventus) tries to score from mid-range after collecting a rebound, but his shot lacks accuracy and sails high over the bar.
36' 2 - 0 Goal! Yerry Mina (Cagliari) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Wojciech Szczesny to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom left corner.
36' Yerry Mina (Cagliari) is going to take the penalty!
35' Wojciech Szczesny (Juventus) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
35' Wojciech Szczesny (Juventus) makes a slide tackle, but referee Marco Piccinini blows for a foul. Cagliari are given a huge opportunity to score - it's a penalty kick!
33' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) latches onto a long ball into the box and unleashes a fine volley at goal, but flashes the effort just wide of the left post. That would have been a great goal!
30' 1 - 0 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) low into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Wojciech Szczesny no chance!
30' Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
29' Here comes the VAR decision. YES, it's a penalty!
29' Referee Marco Piccinini makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
28' Bremer (Juventus) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!

27' Alberto Dossena (Cagliari) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball low to the middle of the goal. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
27' Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
25' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 5:4. The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 1:1.
21' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
19' Zito Luvumbo plays a lofted ball in from the by-line towards Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari), who places his header from near the edge of the six-yard box well wide of the left post.
18' Eldor Shomurodov (Cagliari) sends a cross into the box, but Wojciech Szczesny comes off his line to gather the ball.
15' Eldor Shomurodov (Cagliari) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the middle of the goal is comfortably saved by the goalkeeper.
15' The referee points to the corner flag and Cagliari will take a corner.
14' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. Cagliari win a corner.
10' Federico Gatti (Juventus) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
10' Federico Chiesa (Juventus) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
9' Eldor Shomurodov (Cagliari) is furious with himself as he misses a golden opportunity from inside the six-yard box. He sends a rebound a few inches wide of the left post.
8' Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
6' The game is interrupted now, Carlos Alcaraz (Juventus) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
4' Wasted effort! Ibrahim Sulemana (Cagliari) received a nice pass in space from Gianluca Gaetano, but his long-range shot was weak and floated well wide of the right post.
4' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
2' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) had time and space on the edge of the box but sent his effort just over the bar.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Cagliari will take the kick-off.
Marco Piccinini was nominated as the referee for this game.
